Both plain panes fail. Read the compiler-output pane, not the DXIL: the compile stops at DXIL
validation, so there is no disassembly to inspect. The two lines that matter are the validation
error and the note under it, which reports the module's declared feature-flag word beside the
value the validator recomputed from the final DXIL - the recomputed value is zero.

The third pane is the same source with -DUSE_RAYQUERY, which un-guards the TraceRayInline /
Proceed / CommittedStatus calls so the RayQuery object is actually used. It compiles cleanly and
emits DXIL. Nothing else differs between the panes.

Compiler Explorer runs Linux Release builds and appends -Zi -Qembed_debug; the same three
results were measured locally on a Debug build of main, with and without those flags.
